summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Lucid Diagnostics Inc. announcing the closing of an underwritten offering of 18 million common shares at $1.00 per share, with gross proceeds of $18 million. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement and is a standard capital raise for working capital purposes. There are no special-situation elements such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is a routine current report for a shelf takedown, which does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
